sentence: This project studies whether aging rain gardens still work well for nature, water and people, using inspection reports and a survey of residents.
This project studies how boring sponges wear away oyster reefs and how predators and ocean acidification change that.
This project studies how to make deep networks perform well, train efficiently and stay robust.
This project grows three-dimensional brain cancer models in low gravity to study how tumor force and immune cells affect each other.
This project buys a desktop scanning electron microscope to take detailed pictures for chemistry, engineering and microbiology research.
This project uses deep learning and telescope images to study the initiation of solar flares and to forecast them.
This project builds a way to keep self-driving cars and flying vehicles safe while they learn from data.
This project develops concrete mixtures that have a lower global warming potential and last longer.
This project builds virtual reality tools that help people see and understand vectors, matrices and other ideas in linear algebra.
This project builds mathematical theory that explains how algorithms that use random sampling behave on large datasets.
This project combines several methods for robots to pick up objects and lets the robot look at the scene to collect more information.
This project explores data analytics topics such as cybersecurity, social media analytics and how large data centers perform.
This project studies how city life affects the immune systems of finches and how bird feeders spread bacteria that resist antibiotics.
This project uses laboratory experiments to test whether a yeast and an alga that interact evolve in the same way each time.
